data_description.app_id: Application identifier. Leave the default value unless you know what you are doing.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SaveFamily
reauth_confirm.description: Update the password for this SaveFamily account.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication. Check that the region matches the area selected on the SaveFamily app's login screen, and that the account (email or phone number) and password are exactly the ones you use in the app.
error.upgrade_required: The SaveFamily server refused this client ("please upgrade the app"). The server protocol has probably changed again: check for an update of the integration. See docs/SERVER_LOCKOUT.md.

abort.already_configured: This SaveFamily account is already configured.

set_dnd_schedule.name: Set Do Not Disturb schedule
set_dnd_schedule.description: Replace all Do Not Disturb schedule slots on a supported watch. Omitted slots are cleared. Pass an empty periods list to clear the schedule.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: Up to 4 schedule windows as START-END:DAYS, e.g. 08:00-15:00:mon,tue,wed,thu,fri. Times use the watch's local clock, with start before end. Pass [] to clear all slots.

set_sos_numbers.name: Set SOS numbers
set_sos_numbers.description: Replace the SOS numbers of a watch (up to 5). Omitted slots are cleared; pass [] to clear them all.

call_back.name: Call back (listen in)
call_back.description: Ask the watch to silently call a phone number so you can hear its surroundings.

get_position_history.name: Get position history
get_position_history.description: Return the positions recorded by a watch over a period of at most 24 hours.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period (Home Assistant local time).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period; defaults to now.
